answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network routes identity issuance through a river of verifiable resource commitments where each registered agent must forge an on-chain identity by irreversibly burning cryptographic stake. Each additional clone incurs superlinear cost scaling as $C(n) \propto n^{1.5}$, making counterfeit swarms economically catastrophic while rewarding authentic nodes with a durable pearl of persistent reputation.
